text: This report recommends that City Council approve the donation of a very significant early 19th-century tunebook (the John Buttrey Manuscript) to the City of Toronto. The Buttrey Manuscript will be included in the Historical Collection managed by the Museums and Heritage Services section of Economic Development and Culture and will be displayed, from time to time, at Fort York National Historic Site.

City Council on June 29 and 30, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve accepting Sandra Cameron's donation of the Buttrey Manuscript for inclusion in the City of Toronto's Historical Collection. 2. City Council convey its appreciation to Sandra Cameron for her generous gift to the City of Toronto.
